params.doc: The `typescript` tool also carries a `present` field for hosts that show tool calls in a log, such as [pi-action's workflow log](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/main/docs/extensions.md#show-tool-calls-in-the-workflow-log). pi-durable ignores it. `present.call(args)` gives the call's title, the label from the `// @pit:` header or the `label` argument, and a body: the program without the header, then `params` as JSON, `functionId`, and `saveOnly`. `present.result(args, result)` gives a summary, the functions the program injected such as `workspace.read · git.status` (`saved <name>` for `saveOnly`, the error's first line on failure), and a body: the returned value with string fields as they are and other values as indented JSON, or the error.

## [0.36.4] - 2026-11-14

### Added

- On pi-durable hosts, the `typescript` tool has a `present` field that tells hosts such as pi-action how to show its calls in a log (#372): the label as the title, the program without its `// @pit:` header and its `params`, the functions it injected as the result's summary, and the returned value as readable text, with strings such as file contents and command output as they are instead of escaped JSON. pi-action no longer needs to parse Pit's header itself. See [pi-durable hosts](docs/durable.md#tools-the-model-sees).
